title: Flood / overland flow / storm tide
note: Part of the lot is mapped in a flood planning area. Minimum habitable floor levels, flood-resilient design and limits on filling and intensification are likely to apply.
checklist: Order a Council FloodWise Property Report for flood levels
Confirm the flood planning area category and minimum habitable floor level
Check whether filling or excavation is needed and its flood impacts

title: Heritage
note: The lot is on, or adjoins, a heritage place or pre-1911 building. Demolition and building work can trigger assessment and heritage impact requirements.
checklist: Check the Local Heritage Places register and the Queensland Heritage Register citation
Assess whether a heritage impact statement is needed
Note that any state heritage place is referred to SARA

title: Character protection
code: Traditional building character overlay code / Dwelling house character overlay code / Commercial character building overlay code
note: Character controls restrict demolition or removal of older buildings and require new work to respect the streetscape.
checklist: Establish the house's construction date (pre-1947 is relevant)
Check whether demolition or removal needs approval
Review the design requirements for new work and extensions

title: Bushfire hazard
note: The lot is in a mapped bushfire hazard area. Separation, access and building construction standards (AS 3959) may apply.
checklist: Confirm the hazard level
Obtain a BAL assessment (AS 3959)
Check the access and water supply requirements

title: Landslide / steep land
note: Mapped landslide or steep land hazard. A geotechnical assessment is likely to be required.
checklist: Commission a geotechnical report
Minimise cut and fill and retaining walls

title: Acid sulfate soils
code: Potential and actual acid sulfate soils overlay code
note: Excavation or filling may disturb acid sulfate soils. Testing and a management plan may be required.
checklist: Check excavation depth against the mapped thresholds
Arrange soil testing if excavation is proposed

title: Biodiversity / waterways / vegetation
code: Biodiversity areas overlay code / Waterway corridors overlay code / Wetlands overlay code / Significant landscape tree overlay code
note: Ecological values are mapped on the lot. Vegetation clearing, setbacks from waterways and ecological assessment may be required, and state koala mapping may also apply.
checklist: Map vegetation and waterways on site
Check clearing restrictions and protected vegetation
Check the state koala habitat mapping (SPP / Queensland Globe)

title: Airport environs
note: Height limits (obstacle limitation surfaces), aircraft noise (ANEF) or lighting and wildlife controls may apply.
checklist: Check the building height against the OLS
Check the ANEF contour for noise attenuation

title: Transport noise / air quality
code: Transport noise corridor overlay code / Transport air quality corridor overlay code
note: The lot is near a major road or rail corridor. Acoustic treatment of the building (QDC MP4.4) and air quality design may be required.
checklist: Identify the noise category
Allow for the cost of acoustic glazing and construction

title: Road, transport and infrastructure networks
code: Road hierarchy overlay code / Streetscape hierarchy overlay code / Critical infrastructure and movement network overlay code
note: Frontage roads, access, streetscape treatment and infrastructure corridors can affect driveway location, setbacks and works requirements.
checklist: Confirm the road hierarchy of each frontage
Check access and driveway constraints
Check for any infrastructure easements or corridors

title: Industrial amenity / extractive resources
code: Industrial amenity overlay code / Extractive resources overlay code
note: Nearby industry or extractive resources may limit sensitive uses or require separation and amenity mitigation.
checklist: Identify nearby industry or quarries and their buffers

title: Coastal hazard
note: Coastal erosion or storm tide inundation hazards are mapped on the lot.
checklist: Check the erosion prone area and storm tide levels

title: Neighbourhood plan
note: A neighbourhood plan applies. It can change the levels of assessment, building heights and the uses supported compared with the base zone.
checklist: Read the neighbourhood plan code and its precinct for this lot
Check the neighbourhood plan's tables of assessment

title: Active frontages
code: Active frontages in residential zones overlay code
note: Ground-level activation of the street frontage may be required.
checklist: Plan for ground-floor street activation
